snippet.title: Forcing My Friends To Play My FIGHTING GAME | MIDAS Devlog #4
snippet.description:
Play the full game now!! https://wesgamedesign.itch.io/midas

Hey y'all, Wes here! It's been a minute, but I'm back and ready to show off what I've been cooking for MIDAS. In this (much longer than usual) Devlog I go over my plans for release and show off a ton of multiplayer footage courtesy of my lovely friends. Hope you enjoy!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:40 Where we last left off...
1:25 How I plan to Distribute MIDAS
1:42 Best Scenario for my Players
2:30 Introducing my Friends!!
4:00 How to play!
4:40 Gaming time baby!!!
12:44 One Thing You Liked :)
15:18 One Thing You DIDN'T Like :(
15:45 Outro

Track List:
1. Common | Kuruma de DS
2. Style Savvy | My Room
3. How To Play | SSBM
4. ときめきメモリアル | Song 1
